data.title: Preview: Caykur Rizespor vs Kasimpasa - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
## Team News

Rizespor are expected to be without Khusniddin Alikulov, who is recovering from a knee injury, and Can Bozdogan, while Valentin Mihaila is a doubt with a calf problem.

Sowe has scored four goals in his last two league appearances and will be looking to make the difference again as he leads the line.

Kasimpasa have several potential absentees of their own, with Kamil Corekci, Godfried Frimpong and Mortadha Ben Ouanes among the players carrying injury concerns. [...] Ayberk Karapo is suspended, while the availability of Fousseni Diabate and Kevin Mouanga is also uncertain.

Caykur Rizespor possible starting lineup:

Gorgen; Pala, Mocsi, Bakayoko, Ariss; Antalyali; Mebude, Olawoyin, Laci, Kutucu; Sowe

Kasimpasa possible starting lineup:

Gianniotis; Winck, Arous, Ilie, Jessen; Baldursson, Demirbay; Rak-Sakyi, Hajradinovic, Kol; Benedyczak

## We say: Caykur Rizespor 1-2 Kasimpasa [...] They will look to build on that form against a side they beat 3-0 in their last meeting, while they can also take encouragement from recording their first home victory of the season after losing their opening four league games at Caykur Didi Stadium.

Kasimpasa, meanwhile, have put together an impressive sequence of results and arrive in Rize having won four of their last five league matches, with their only dropped points during that period coming in a 2-2 draw against Besiktas.
